AI Agent

You might say

I don't want to direct every step. Can I give it a goal and let it figure out how to finish it?

An AI system that can plan steps, use permitted tools, and act on results toward a goal·To fix a page, an agent can read the relevant file, edit it, run a check, and report what passed. It only has the tools, permissions, and context the product gives it.
Know first

How an agent moves from a request to checked work
AI Agent
You

Fix the navigation overflow on small screens, then verify it yourself.

Agent runtime
Permission: project filesHigh-risk actions need confirmationStart
  1. Readread_file("nav.jsx")Round 1 round
  2. InspectObservation: 84 lines; no small-screen media queryRound 1 round
  3. Changepatch nav.jsx: horizontal scrolling on small screensRound 2 round
  4. Runnpm run build → ✓ passedRound 2 round
Task recorded: fix small-screen navigation overflow and verify it when finished.

A goal can span several steps. The Agent records the task and success criteria before rushing to an answer.

What matters is not that an Agent can chat, but that it can act from results within controlled boundaries and knows when to stop.

What makes an agent more than a chat reply

Set a goal and constraints: The product gives the agent a task, protected scope, and the information it needs.

Use permitted tools: The model can request reads, edits, or checks, but the runtime controls what it may do.

Report from evidence: Real tool results, file changes, and tests determine whether the task is actually complete.

What people often confuse

An agent is not automatically authorized or correct. Its permissions, tool results, and verification still determine what it can safely claim.

You can say this to an AI Agent

“

The cause of this sign-in failure is unclear. Read the error and relevant code first, then choose the checks you need. Run the relevant test after each change. Do not alter unrelated features or read real secrets. Stop when tests pass and show the evidence; ask me before making a product decision.

Quick decision

AI agent vs chatbot: what is the difference?

A chatbot describes the conversational interface; an AI agent describes a goal-directed workflow that uses results to decide the next step. One product can be both.

Decision pointAI AgentChatbot
What it describesA workflow that takes actions, observes results, and continues toward a goal.An interface where people and an AI exchange messages.
How work continuesUses tool output or other observations to choose another action or stop.Organizes interaction as turns; it may answer directly or provide access to an agent workflow.
Typical workflowInspects repository files, edits code, runs tests, and verifies fixes before concluding.Explains why an error occurred based on text pasted into the chat prompt.
Investigating an application bug

A chatbot can explain an error from the details you provide. An AI agent can take on the goal of fixing it: read files, edit code, run tests, and use the results to decide whether more work is needed. A chat interface may be how you control that agent.
